scope: Four original SOURCE_ANSWER questions only; no original case PASS, original16case gate closure, held-out evaluation, fresh primary research or promotion.

cases.question: Are Memory Tax and MemoryTax one paper, and do they prove that summaries should replace original sources?
original_answer_requirements: The former was reviewed selectively and motivates original-history recovery; the latter abstract-only review reports narrow sampling and caption confounds.
Neither proves a gain in this harness or justifies deleting originals.
original_must_not: Conflate paper identities/read depths or claim local replication.
required_assertions: Distinct papers:2610.34073v1 versus2610.29823; do not collapse titles/identities.
The former is reported selectively reviewed, not replicated; original-history recovery alongside derived memory is a design lead.
The latter is reported abstract-only, with narrow sampling and caption-visibility confounds; not a replication of the eleven-system comparison.
Neither establishes this harness performance or a universal summary-replacement/deletion rule; preserve an original-source recovery path.
forbidden_claims: Same study or interchangeable evidence/read depths.
Both primary bodies fully read or locally replicated.
Summaries universally beat originals, originals may be deleted, or this harness has measured gains.
cases.uncertainty: Read depth and limitations are historical local reports; primary validity/freshness and local transfer remain untested.

cases.question: Can the RAW-RAG results certify that our local engineering assistant is better?
original_answer_requirements: Reported results concern offline conversational tasks.
Selected method/limitations were historically read; no matched local engineering/operations improvement follows.
Compare against current scoped retrieval on frozen tasks, same reader/source visibility and complete usage.
original_must_not: Treat paper ranking or a source map as local adoption/efficacy.
required_assertions: Reported RAW-RAG evidence concerns offline conversation-QA, not a certified local engineering improvement.
Selected primary method/limitations were historically reviewed; report reading is not a fresh primary read or local replication.
Any local comparison needs frozen authorized cases, current scoped retrieval baseline, same reader/source visibility/evidence budget and full usage.
Paper ranking/source map does not establish local SWE/dev-ops efficacy or operational permission/state behavior.
forbidden_claims: Paper ranking certifies this harness is better or an operational system is qualified.
Local lexical overlapping windows replicate the dense/reranked RAW-RAG system.
Proposed baseline is an adopted authority store or permits private-session ingestion.
cases.uncertainty: No matched local efficacy/complete usage result follows from these reports; reported primary-method depth is historical.

cases.question: Did the Linux Foundation announcement say Alibaba contributed OpenEnv, or prove a 30 percent coding gain?
original_answer_requirements: It contradicts Alibaba/OpenEnv and attributes OpenEnv to Hugging Face.
It does not support a 30 percent coding improvement; keep reported date and lack of fresh revalidation explicit.
original_must_not: Conflate source accessibility with support or repeat unsupported numbers.
required_assertions: The26October2026 smoke report records the publisher announcement as supporting Alibaba/OpenSandbox.
That report contradicts Alibaba/OpenEnv and attributes OpenEnv to Hugging Face.
The report marks the30percent coding-gain assertion NOT_SUPPORTED; no such measured result was reported there.
Keep report date and lack of fresh publisher revalidation explicit; access and adjacent-claim support are separate.
forbidden_claims: A successful page open/citation establishes every claim, or this task freshly verified the publisher page.
The deliberately synthetic URL is a real publication, or browser refusal alone established its404.
cases.uncertainty: These are historical reported results, not current publisher bytes. Not-supported is narrower than proving every possible performance claim false.

cases.question: What method does the unread beamnxw source recommend, and is it adopted?
original_answer_requirements: No verified primary content is present in the selected source map.
Return an uninspected lead and missing read/support/adoption evidence.
original_must_not: Invent source content from account/title or turn a pointer into a read.
required_assertions: The selected source-map row has no verified primary content for beamnxw.
Treat it as an unread/uninspected lead: method/support/adoption evidence missing; no architecture edge or installation established.
Do not derive a method from title/account name or infer adoption from a pointer.

adjudication_contract.authority: Root independently checks current hashes/lines, freezes and adjudicates criteria against original requirements before native outputs. This authored rubric is not an executed grade or independent oracle certificate.
adjudication_contract.preservation: Original answer requirements and must_not copied unchanged. Semantic equivalents accepted; no phrase/token/heading match or new numerical score/threshold. Criteria unpack original meanings; root resolves any added burden instead of silently changing acceptance.
adjudication_contract.per_assertion: Record supported/missing/contradicted/indeterminate with actual output quote and exact retrieved report span. Missing required assertion in a completed response is not a pass. Forbidden assertion is an explicit failure; never average it away.
adjudication_contract.uncertainty: A justified scoped abstention can preserve safety while failing useful required recall if eligible evidence existed but retrieval omitted it. Do not relabel retrieval misses as source absence.
adjudication_contract.absence: No response/execution/provenance => NOT_RUN; unresolved support => INCONCLUSIVE; absent usage => UNKNOWN. Original statuses remain untouched.
adjudication_contract.calibration: Root tests sound semantic equivalents and meaning-breaking counterclaims against the original requirements before trusting instrument scores. This document supplies no executed control result.

evidence_axes.source_report_support: Local report bytes/spans can support a correctly attributed historical statement. Source hashes prove identity, not entailment; each output claim needs independent meaning adjudication.
evidence_axes.primary_truth: NOT_REVALIDATED. No primary paper/publisher/post body acquired in this task. Report labels of past reads are not new worker primary reads.
evidence_axes.retrieval_trace: NOT_RUN. Bind full eligible corpus/query, arm/version/settings, exact candidates/selected spans/scores/hashes, evidence truncation/dedup and output budget. Supplied excerpts alone show consumption, not autonomous discovery.
evidence_axes.native_outcome: NOT_RUN. Bind reader model/effort/tools/session, prompt/actual presented evidence, output/citations/status and all attempts; raw stdout/schema does not authenticate judgment.
evidence_axes.control_recovery: Four SOURCE_ANSWER tasks do not replay correction/withdrawal/scope controls or normal producer/cold-reader chain.

comparison_boundary.arms: Existing section lexical versus overlapping raw-source windows with lexical scoring. Same full eligible local corpus and exact questions, model/effort/tools and reader/evidence budgets. Selected spans may differ as the treatment.
comparison_boundary.no_replication: Window baseline is local lexical development calibration, not replication of dense/reranked RAW-RAG. No semantic dependency or source expansion.
comparison_boundary.original_gate: No per-case quality/scope/correction regression AND aggregate tokens<=baseline. No threshold or original gate modification; four cases cannot qualify all16.
comparison_boundary.usage: Capture ingestion/maintenance/retrieval/reader/worker/retry/review/orchestration per arm, failures and setup; disclose provider subset semantics, no double count. Historical failed-call usage remains UNKNOWN and cannot be erased by prospective complete usage.
comparison_boundary.limits: One visible finite comparison cannot establish causal generality, held-out transfer, trained skill, broad privacy/recovery or stable release/device parity.

authoring: Local allowed reports and prior input read; byte/span bindings authored. No tests, gates, native/model calls, web/service acquisition, runtime/config/guard edits or original-source changes. Root verification NOT_RUN.
